title: A confined coordinator fetches its non-default base branch over SSH despite foreign-owned system ssh includes
description: Under real bubblewrap, with a root-owned file in /etc/ssh/ssh_config.d that the user namespace reads as owned by nobody: the confined session fetches graphyard-main from a fixture SSH origin with the merge writer's deploy-key environment, real ssh resolves its configuration with host-key checking at accept-new, verification runs on the fetched base, and the loop's fetch-refusal line names an ssh configuration ownership refusal as that host fault rather than a SAML or deploy-key authorization failure.
